title: Darkmoon Security Posture — Demo

panels.title: Estate
panels.description: Projects / Targets / Campaigns / total Findings across the estate.

panels.title: Active campaigns
panels.description: Campaigns currently running.

panels.title: Critical
panels.description: Critical-severity findings across the estate.

panels.title: High
panels.description: High-severity findings across the estate.

panels.title: Exploited
panels.description: Findings Darkmoon actively EXPLOITED (proof-of-impact).

panels.title: Confirmed
panels.description: Findings confirmed present (not yet exploited).

panels.title: Remediation rate
panels.description: Share of findings marked remediated. (MTTR is intentionally NOT shown: the data model carries no per-finding open/close timestamps, so it cannot be computed honestly.)

panels.title: Findings over time (by severity)
panels.description: Per-campaign finding counts by severity over time (mirrors the Angular Vulnerability Evolution chart).

panels.title: Severity distribution
panels.description: Findings by severity (colors match the app badges).

panels.title: Status distribution
panels.description: Findings by exploitation/remediation status.

panels.title: Last campaigns
panels.description: Recent campaigns. Click a campaign id to drill down.

panels.title: Targets at risk
panels.description: Targets at critical/high/medium risk. Click a host to drill down.

panels.title: Vulnerabilities
panels.description: All findings (safe fields only — NO description, NO evidence). Every column is filterable (click the column header funnel to filter by severity / status / category / campaign). Click a title to drill into the finding.

panels.title: MITRE ATT&CK
panels.description: Findings grouped by MITRE ATT&CK technique.

panels.title: Category breakdown
panels.description: Findings grouped by vulnerability category.

panels.title: Technologies
panels.description: Technology stack discovered across targets.

panels.title: Pull requests (remediation)
panels.description: Remediation pull requests (Pro). Human-reviewed, never auto-merged.

panels.title: Retest verdicts
panels.description: Derived retest verdicts (fixed / still_present / regressed / new). Set the retest_id variable to a retest run.

panels.title: Retest / regression detail
panels.description: Per-finding retest verdict comparing the base vs new campaign.

panels.title: Campaign ${campaign_id} — stats
panels.description: Stats for the campaign selected via drill-down (campaign_id variable).

panels.title: Finding ${vuln_id} — detail (safe fields only)
panels.description: Finding metadata (NEVER description/evidence/raw). Selected via the vuln_id drill-down variable.

panels.title: Finding ${vuln_id} — evidence metadata (counts only, never content)
panels.description: Evidence PRESENCE and COUNTS only. This panel proves the two-key redaction rule: content is never fetched or rendered.

description: Darkmoon Security Posture — mirrors the Darkmoon web app. Overview KPIs, findings over time, severity/status distributions, campaigns, targets, vulnerabilities, MITRE ATT&CK, technologies, remediation PRs and retest verdicts. Safe fields only — never renders evidence or report bodies.
